title: Runtime API and operational documentation still contains endpoint/schema and process-lifecycle drift

original_titles.title: Configuration surface deviates wholesale from spec variable groups (no PG_*/STORAGE_KIND/AI_*/RUNNER_*/SMTP_*/staging/FEATURE_*)
Stages addressed by ordinal level number instead of a stable stage_key; no Deprecation/Sunset mechanism
Challenge URLs use UUIDs, not slugs
Landing performs an extra dynamic call GET /v1/time beyond the spec's single cached event fetch
document.title never set per page (one-h1 rule is met)

problem: The repo has current source and some updated runbooks, but several specification path conventions, deployment settings, stage addressing and page/title behaviors differ from the reference design. Some are intentional design choices, others are documentation drift; they should not be treated as security defects without owner confirmation.
impact: Unresolved API/documentation deviations make integrators rely on stale endpoint names and can break external tooling or training materials.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Classify each deviation as an accepted design decision, compatibility alias requirement or defect. Record it in a short ADR/requirements reconciliation table.
For external API naming changes, provide compatibility aliases with deprecation dates instead of silently switching paths.
Make docs generated or checked from OpenAPI where possible; add stale endpoint checks in CI.
Add page-specific document.title and focus-to-heading behavior if required by the user-facing accessibility standard.
Remove outdated process, service and configuration instructions from operational docs once deployment artifacts are finalized.

acceptance_criteria: Every API deviation has a decision owner and status.
Current docs match routes and event operations.
No current runbook calls a removed endpoint.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
